# tests/fixtures/review/

Fixtures for the v0.2 review / lock / diff module. Every name here is
FICTIONAL; the project used by the tests is `examples/lecturer-no-ai/`
loaded at test time, with these extra objects merged in:

- `mappings.yaml` — two mapping proposals (one human-proposed, one
  AI-proposed with a requester), all `PROPOSED`, for the accept / reject
  tests. Names are synthetic reviewer personas, not people.
